data.one_liner: Flutter package for managing a shopping cart with add/remove, quantity updates, totals and optional persistence.
data.what_it_does: It provides a FlutterCart class to initialize, add items, update quantities, remove items, clear the cart, apply discounts, and retrieve totals and item lists. Persistence can be enabled via shared_preferences.
use_when: You need a lightweight cart solution without pulling in a full state‑management library
You want simple persistence of cart data across app launches
avoid_when: You require reactive streams or Bloc‑style state updates
You need secure or encrypted storage for cart data
Your cart data is large or relational and needs a database
strengths: Very easy to integrate and use
weaknesses: Only key‑value persistence, not suitable for large data sets
No built‑in reactive or stream API
data.setup_notes: Call FlutterCart().initializeCart(isPersistenceSupportEnabled: true) before runApp; ensure shared_preferences is added (already a dependency).

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a full SQLite database for larger or more complex cart data and supports queries beyond simple key‑value storage
